 "data": "---
config:
 theme: base
 themeVariables:
 fontFamily: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
 actorBkg: \"#e7f5ff\"
 actorBorder: \"#1c7ed6\"
 actorTextColor: \"#212529\"
 actorLineColor: \"#adb5bd\"
 signalColor: \"#495057\"
 signalTextColor: \"#212529\"
 noteBkgColor: \"#fff9db\"
 noteBorderColor: \"#b59f00\"
 noteTextColor: \"#212529\"
 labelBoxBkgColor: \"#f1f3f5\"
 labelBoxBorderColor: \"#868e96\"
 loopTextColor: \"#212529\"
 sequenceNumberColor: \"#ffffff\"
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor U as 👤 Usuário
 box rgb(231,245,255) Serviço
 participant A as 🖥️ video-api (via gateway)
 end
 box rgb(235,251,238) Dados gerenciados
 participant D as 🐘 PostgreSQL
 participant S as 🪣 S3
 end
 box rgb(255,244,230) Mensageria
 participant Q as 📨 SQS
 end
 box rgb(231,245,255) Processamento
 participant W as ⚙️ video-worker
 end
 U->>A: POST /videos
 A->>D: Transação curta: reservar limpeza do objeto
 A->>S: Enviar original fora da transação
 A->>D: Transação: cancelar limpeza + vídeo QUEUED + outbox
 A-->>U: 201 + id + QUEUED
 A-)Q: Publisher envia evento e confirma outbox
 Q-)W: VideoUploadRequested
 W->>S: Adquirir lease do vídeo
 W-)Q: PROCESSING_STARTED
 Q-)A: Atualizar status
 W->>S: Verificar ZIP existente ou baixar original
 W->>W: Extrair frames e compactar
 W->>S: Persistir ZIP
 W-)Q: PROCESSING_COMPLETED
 W->>Q: Excluir mensagem processada
 Q-)A: Aplicar resultado no banco
 U->>A: GET /videos e GET /videos/{id}/download
 A->>S: Ler ZIP privado
 A-->>U: Streaming do ZIP",
